subject: English
title: CBSE English, Class IX

source.read: Directorate of Education, Delhi: Class IX English Language and Literature (184) annual syllabus 2026-27, which follows the CBSE curriculum and the new book Kaveri
source.note: UNOFFICIAL SOURCE. A state education department's copy of the CBSE syllabus, read through a text summary of the PDF. The board's prescribed chapters are named, not reproduced; the course is examined mainly through the textbooks, which are not in the app.

licence: Strand names as printed (facts). Every outcome is written by OpenPath in its own words; no curriculum or textbook text is reproduced.
review: OpenPath curriculum inventory (AI-assisted research from secondary sources; not an educator review)

outcomes.text: Reads a long descriptive or discursive passage and answers questions on it.
Reads a short case-based passage with data or a chart and answers questions.
outcomes.note: Reading passages have questions, and charts are read in Notes, charts and maps; long passages built on data are not yet in the app.

outcomes.text: Writes a notice and an informal invitation of about fifty words.
outcomes.note: Written here or on paper to a task set for this class. The learner checks it against a short list and a grown-up ticks what they see. The app does not keep or mark the writing; the essay studio gives a closer analysis where an evaluator is connected.

outcomes.text: Uses modals for ability, permission, duty, possibility and advice.
